title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
dek: Capacity labels are not all written the same way. Compare them carefully.
status: Published as a working draft. No named editor (FLG-R12).

body.text: Listing titles state capacity in different formats. {{P-01}} says '6 Quart'. {{P-02}} says '26QT'. {{P-03}} says '8 Qt'. Those are title labels, not measurements we checked.

items: Find the capacity figure in the product information table, not only in the title.
Check whether the figure refers to the whole appliance or to one basket or tray. Titles do not always say which.
Compare figures in the same unit. If one listing gives quarts and another gives litres, convert both yourself before comparing.
Ask how many people you usually cook for, and compare that with any serving or family-size wording on the listing.

body.text: We did not convert or compare capacity figures across listings, and we did not measure any appliance.
